AccrualDetail.title: AccrualDetail
AccrualDetail.description: `evm.rebasing_accrual`: a rebasing token's growth over an interval that no transfer explains (units/evm/index.md rule 19).

AssetInfo.title: AssetInfo
AssetInfo.description: Native display facts of one leg asset (units/evm/index.md rule 7.4).

AssetVerdict.title: AssetVerdict
AssetVerdict.description: Mark a token of the resource as the owner's (`mine`), as `spam`, or `clear` a mark (units/evm/index.md rules 13.1, 16).

Balance.title: Balance
Balance.description:
A ledger balance: the sum of the legs of one non-perpetual asset (rule 46.1).

A perpetual's legs sum to its position's `size`, which is served in `positions` with the
`instrument` (rule 34.1); balances hold `asset`, `nft` and `share` keys only.

Binding.title: Binding
Binding.description: A resource is one `(network, address)` (units/evm/index.md rule 1).

BridgeDetail.title: BridgeDetail
BridgeDetail.description: `evm.bridge_initiate`, `evm.bridge_claim`: value sent to or received from another chain; the main leg is `transfer`, others `fee`.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: `GET`/`PUT …/resources/{r}/budget` (rule 4.6, rule 16 row 23): a hard limit set by a tenant admin (policy 02 access rule 7.2).

BudgetRequest.title: BudgetRequest
BudgetRequest.description: `PUT …/budget`: the hard limit and what it covers.

Cash.title: Cash
Cash.description: The settled cash view of a `notional` margin compartment (rule 46.2).

ChangesPage.title: ChangesPage
ChangesPage.description: `GET …/changes` (sync.md rule 9): litmus-state's page with the schema and resource header.

Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
Checkpoint.description: One comparison of the records' balance with an independent source (rule 48).

EditPage.title: EditPage
EditPage.description: `GET …/edits`: the active set (applied, not withdrawn), or every edit with `all`, oldest first (rules 7.3.3, 15).

EditResolve.title: EditResolve
EditResolve.description: An edit whose application clears the item (rule 50.2).

EditWithdrawal.title: EditWithdrawal
EditWithdrawal.description: The withdrawal of an applied edit: staged by `DELETE …/edits/{e}`, applied by the next sync (rule 7.3.2).

Endpoint.title: Endpoint
Endpoint.description: One side of a bridge, as the evidence names it; for display only (rule 37.6).

Endpoints.title: Endpoints
Endpoints.description: Source and destination of a bridged movement.

Estimate.title: Estimate
Estimate.description: Approximate provider cost of one sync, priced on the network's primary provider.

EvidenceChange.title: EvidenceChange
EvidenceChange.description: An evidence entry added to or retired from the closure after `since`.

EvidenceFragment.title: EvidenceFragment
EvidenceFragment.description: The part of an evidence object a locator points at (rule 13.2).

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
EvidenceRef.description: One evidence object a record derives from (rule 27).

ExchangeDetail.title: ExchangeDetail
ExchangeDetail.description: `evm.swap`, `evm.wrap`: an exchange through a DEX, aggregator, settlement contract or the wrapped native token.

ExecutionDetail.title: ExecutionDetail
ExecutionDetail.description: `evm.execution`: the address sent the transaction and paid its fee (its only leg, `gas`).

Facility.title: Facility
Facility.description: The lending market the address owes (units/evm/index.md term 4).

FactRef.title: FactRef
FactRef.description: A decoded fact that formed (part of) the record.

Instrument.title: Instrument
Instrument.description: A perpetual as the catalogue currently resolves it; attached at read, never stored (rule 34).

JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted
JobAccepted.description: The `202` body of every job route (rule 4.2).

JobActor.title: JobActor
JobActor.description: Who started the job (policy 02 access rule 5).

JobError.title: JobError
JobError.description: Why a job failed: the failure's type name and message, never a traceback.

Leg.title: Leg
Leg.description: One signed balance effect of a record on one `(compartment, asset)` (rule 30).

LoanDetail.title: LoanDetail
LoanDetail.description: `evm.loan`: a borrow or repayment against a facility; the owed asset moves in `debt:<pool>` (units/evm/index.md rules 8, 20).

MeterUsage.title: MeterUsage
MeterUsage.description: One meter's total: provider cost in USD plus the raw quantity (policy 02 interfaces rule 10.2).

Moment.title: Moment
Moment.description: The block and time of a transfer the activity probe read.

NetworkList.title: NetworkList
NetworkList.description: The networks of the unit configuration.

Operation.title: Operation
Operation.description: The position operation of a liquidity or position record (units/evm/index.md rule 10.5).

OwnAddresses.title: OwnAddresses
OwnAddresses.description: Other addresses the owner controls: movements from them are solicited (units/evm/index.md rule 13.3).

PayloadChange.title: PayloadChange
PayloadChange.description: A payload written after `since`, as it is now.

Position.title: Position
Position.description: An open perpetual position with venue facts only (rule 46.3); `size` is the sum of its `perpetual` legs.

PositionDetail.title: PositionDetail
PositionDetail.description: `evm.liquidity` (assets given or received and the receipt, `liquidity`) and `evm.position` (legless).

Probe.title: Probe
Probe.description: One network's activity, its display identity, the first-sync estimate and what the probe cost.

ProbeReport.title: ProbeReport
ProbeReport.description: The activity probe of one address over several networks.

ProbeRequest.title: ProbeRequest
ProbeRequest.description: The address and, optionally, the networks to probe.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: Every non-2xx body (rule 14, RFC 9457), plus typed extension members.

RecordChange.title: RecordChange
RecordChange.description: A record written after `since`, as it is now: its stored body is the record.

RediscoverRequest.title: RediscoverRequest
RediscoverRequest.description: The inclusive height window every feed, the node block scan included, is asked for again.

ResourceCreate.title: ResourceCreate
ResourceCreate.description: A new resource: its name and its immutable binding (rule 2.1).

ResourceDeletion.title: ResourceDeletion
ResourceDeletion.description: `DELETE /resources/{r}`: the resource, its state and its change log are gone (rule 2.4).

ResourcePage.title: ResourcePage
ResourcePage.description: `GET /resources` (rule 15): only the resources the credential covers.

ResourceUsage.title: ResourceUsage
ResourceUsage.description: `GET …/resources/{r}/usage` (rule 4.5, rule 16 row 22): what the resource's jobs spent in the period.

RouteResolve.title: RouteResolve
RouteResolve.description: A route whose call clears the item (rule 50.2); never a command line.

SyncRequest.title: SyncRequest
SyncRequest.description: What to sync: a height, switches and the rebasing accrual schedule (the binding is fixed).

TenantUsage.title: TenantUsage
TenantUsage.description: What the tenant spent outside any resource (probes) in the period.

TransferCount.title: TransferCount
TransferCount.description: How many transfers one `alchemy_getAssetTransfers` page of the activity probe held.

TransferDetail.title: TransferDetail
TransferDetail.description: `evm.transfer`: one movement no fact explains (deposit, withdrawal, airdrop, poisoning).

TxKind.title: TxKind
TxKind.description: Impose a record kind on one transaction: its unflagged movements form one record of the kind (units/evm/index.md rule 13.2).

UnknownDetail.title: UnknownDetail
UnknownDetail.description: `evm.unknown`: an event the unit could not serve as its kind; every leg is `unknown` and an `evm.unknown_record` item says why (contract rules 43, 28.1).

UsageOverview.title: UsageOverview
UsageOverview.description: `GET /usage` (rule 16 row 22): one page of the covered resources' usage, by name, and the tenant's own.

litmus__evm__application__probe__Activit.title: Activity
litmus__evm__application__probe__Activit.description: What the probe read; a field is `None` when its call failed.

litmus__evm__domain__budget__Activity.title: Activity
litmus__evm__domain__budget__Activity.description: The counts an estimate is computed from.

HTTPBearer.description: Platform session token, job token or lt_ API key
